title: Never use unwrap or expect in production Rust
content:
What: Propagate errors with Result and typed AppError instead of unwrap/expect.
Why: Unhandled panics crash the HTTP worker under malformed webhook payloads.
Where: crates/api/src and crates/worker/src.
Learned: Enforce via sai check rule rust-no-unwrap.

title: Use Bun for frontend scripts and tests
content:
What: Always run bun install, bun run check, and bun test in apps/portal.
Why: Lockfile and workspace scripts target Bun runtime.
Where: apps/portal/package.json.
Learned: Never mix npm or yarn lockfiles into the repo.

title: Format and lint TypeScript with Biome
content:
What: Run bunx biome check before finishing frontend edits.
Why: Keeps imports, quotes, and lint rules consistent without ESLint overhead.
Where: apps/portal/biome.json.
Learned: CI fails on unformatted TSX files.

title: Store and compare all timestamps in UTC
content:
What: Persist DateTime<Utc> in PostgreSQL timestamptz columns and serialize ISO-8601 UTC.
Why: Local offsets caused off-by-one-day billing cutoffs around midnight.
Where: crates/core/src/time.rs and invoices queries.
Learned: Convert to tenant timezone only at display time.

title: Never mock the database in repository tests
content:
What: Test repository queries against a real in-memory or ephemeral DB with migrations.
Why: Mocks hid FTS5 syntax errors and foreign key cascade bugs.
Where: crates/core/tests/.
Learned: Keep fixtures small so full migration runs stay under 10ms.

title: User-facing CLI and portal errors in Spanish
content:
What: Write user messages, labels, and CLI help strings in Spanish.
Why: Operations team and support dashboards use Spanish terminology.
Where: crates/cli/src and apps/portal/src/locales.
Learned: Keep code identifiers, SQL, and logs in English.

title: Idempotency keys for payment charges
content:
What: Require Idempotency-Key header on POST /v1/charges backed by a unique constraint.
Why: Mobile retries on flaky networks previously double-charged customers.
Where: crates/api/src/routes/charges.rs.
Learned: Cache response status and body for 24 hours keyed by tenant and key.

title: Stripe webhook signature verification
content:
What: Verify Stripe-Signature HMAC-SHA256 over the raw request body bytes before JSON parsing.
Why: Parsing and re-serializing JSON alters whitespace and breaks signature checks.
Where: crates/api/src/webhooks/stripe.rs.
Learned: Reject timestamps older than 300 seconds to prevent replay attacks.

title: PostgreSQL connection pool configuration
content:
What: Run PgBouncer in transaction pooling mode with max 40 backend connections and 15s idle timeout.
Why: Direct connections hit PostgreSQL max_connections during traffic spikes.
Where: deploy/pgbouncer.ini and crates/core/src/db.rs.
Learned: Disable prepared statement caching in SQLx when using transaction pooling.

title: Rate limiting with Redis token bucket
content:
What: Enforce per-tenant API limits using an atomic Lua token bucket script in Redis.
Why: Fixed window counters allowed double bursts across minute boundaries.
Where: crates/api/src/middleware/ratelimit.rs.
Learned: Fail open with a warning metric if Redis times out past 25ms.

title: JWT RS256 key rotation via JWKS
content:
What: Sign access tokens with RS256 and publish active and previous public keys at /.well-known/jwks.json.
Why: Enables zero-downtime key rotation every 30 days without invalidating active sessions.
Where: crates/auth/src/jwks.rs.
Learned: Include kid header in every minted token and cache JWKS for 5 minutes.

title: Transactional outbox for billing events
content:
What: Insert domain events into outbox_events in the same DB transaction as invoice state changes.
Why: Publishing to NATS after commit lost events when the process crashed mid-request.
Where: crates/billing/src/outbox.rs.
Learned: Worker polls with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED every 250ms.

title: Use UUIDv7 for primary keys
content:
What: Generate time-ordered UUIDv7 IDs in application code for all primary entities.
Why: Random UUIDv4 caused heavy B-tree page splits on high-volume ledger inserts.
Where: crates/core/src/ids.rs.
Learned: Preserves chronological sorting without exposing sequential integer counts.

title: Cursor pagination on invoice listings
content:
What: Paginate GET /v1/invoices using an opaque base64 (created_at, id) cursor instead of OFFSET.
Why: Deep OFFSET queries scanned tens of thousands of rows during monthly reconciliation.
Where: crates/api/src/routes/invoices.rs.
Learned: Always request limit + 1 rows to determine has_more cleanly.

title: Soft delete tenants with archived_at
content:
What: Mark deactivated records with archived_at instead of hard DELETE on financial tables.
Why: Audit trail and chargeback disputes require immutable historical invoice links.
Where: migrations/20260410_archived_at.sql.
Learned: Filter WHERE archived_at IS NULL in default repository queries.

title: Truncar secretos en logs estructurados JSON
content:
What: Emit tracing JSON logs and redact authorization headers, tokens, and card PANs.
Why: Raw header dumps once leaked bearer secrets into central log aggregation.
Where: crates/core/src/telemetry.rs.
Learned: Wrap sensitive fields in a Redacted newtype implementing Debug and Display.

title: Workspace crate boundaries for novapay-api
content:
What: Split workspace into core, auth, billing, api, and worker crates with acyclic dependencies.
Why: Keeps domain rules testable without booting HTTP or queue servers.
Where: Cargo.toml workspace members.
Learned: Only api and worker depend on infrastructure adapters.

title: Double-entry ledger schema design
content:
What: Record every monetary movement as balanced debit and credit postings summing to zero per journal.
Why: Single balance columns made reconciliation drifts impossible to trace.
Where: crates/billing/src/ledger.rs.
Learned: Enforce sum(amount_cents) = 0 per journal_id via deferred constraint trigger.

title: Outbound webhook delivery worker pipeline
content:
What: Dispatch customer webhooks from a dedicated async worker with exponential backoff and dead-letter queue.
Why: Slow customer endpoints previously stalled HTTP request handlers.
Where: crates/worker/src/webhook_dispatcher.rs.
Learned: Sign outbound payloads reusing webhooks-stripe-hmac conventions.

title: Multi-tenant PostgreSQL Row-Level Security
content:
What: Isolate tenant tables with RLS policies reading app.current_tenant_id set per transaction.
Why: Prevents cross-tenant data leaks even if a handler forgets a WHERE tenant_id clause.
Where: migrations/20260502_rls_policies.sql.
Learned: Set via SET LOCAL inside transactions so db-pgbouncer-pool never leaks tenant context.

title: S3 presigned URLs for PDF receipts
content:
What: Generate 10-minute S3 presigned GET URLs for invoice PDFs instead of streaming bytes through API.
Why: Offloads bandwidth and keeps API pods stateless and fast.
Where: crates/billing/src/receipts.rs.
Learned: Set Content-Disposition attachment with sanitized invoice number.

title: Route reporting queries to read replicas
content:
What: Send heavy analytics and CSV exports to the read-only replica pool.
Why: Monthly financial reports starved write transactions on the primary instance.
Where: crates/core/src/db_pools.rs.
Learned: Never route read-after-write auth checks to replicas due to replication lag.

title: OAuth2 PKCE flow for admin portal
content:
What: Authenticate portal operators using Authorization Code + PKCE S256 and short-lived tokens.
Why: Implicit flow exposed tokens in browser history and URL fragments.
Where: crates/auth/src/oauth_pkce.rs.
Learned: Bind state parameter to an HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie.

title: Internal gRPC settlement service contract
content:
What: Communicate batch payouts to the clearing service over tonic gRPC with mTLS.
Why: Protobuf schemas catch breaking field changes across services at compile time.
Where: proto/settlement/v1/settlement.proto.
Learned: Set explicit 5s per-RPC deadlines on every stub call.

title: Invoice rounding drift in tax calculation
content:
What: Compute VAT per line item in integer minor units using banker's rounding before summing.
Why: Rounding floating-point percentages on the subtotal caused 1-cent mismatches against Stripe.
Where: crates/billing/src/tax.rs.
Learned: Never use f64 for money; store integer cents and rust_decimal for rates.

title: Lock ordering for concurrent balance updates
content:
What: Sort account IDs ascending before acquiring SELECT ... FOR UPDATE locks in transfers.
Why: Simultaneous A->B and B->A transfers acquired row locks in opposite orders and deadlocked.
Where: crates/billing/src/transfer.rs.
Learned: Deterministic lock acquisition eliminates circular waits under high concurrency.

title: Duplicate Stripe webhook delivery race condition
content:
What: Insert stripe_event_id into processed_events with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING before processing.
Why: Stripe occasionally fires two concurrent deliveries before the first finishes committing.
Where: crates/api/src/webhooks/stripe.rs.
Learned: Check rows_affected == 0 and return 200 OK immediately on duplicates.

title: Redis cache TTL for session tokens
content:
What: Reset EXPIRE 1800 on every sliding session refresh using SETEX instead of SET without TTL.
Why: Plain SET cleared the existing expiry in Redis, leaving stale sessions alive forever.
Where: crates/auth/src/session_store.rs.
Learned: Always pass KEEPTTL or explicit EX on Redis writes.

title: CORS allowed origins and headers configuration
content:
What: Allow Authorization, Idempotency-Key, and Content-Type in tower-http CorsLayer.
Why: Browser preflight OPTIONS failed when the portal sent Idempotency-Key on POST /charges.
Where: crates/api/src/cors.rs.
Learned: Read allowed origins from CORS_ORIGINS env var without wildcard when credentials=true.

title: Monthly VAT report boundary timezone bug
content:
What: Convert reporting month start/end from Europe/Madrid local midnight to UTC bounds.
Why: Querying UTC month boundaries shifted invoices issued between 23:00 and 00:00 UTC.
Where: crates/billing/src/vat_report.rs.
Learned: Apply chrono-tz on query window inputs while keeping storage per time-utc-standard.

title: Connection pool exhaustion during CSV exports
content:
What: Stream export rows with sqlx::fetch() into a bounded channel instead of holding connections while buffering.
Why: Large exports held DB connections across slow client writes and exhausted the pool.
Where: crates/api/src/routes/exports.rs.
Learned: Release the pool connection before gzip compression and S3 upload.

title: Whitelist dynamic sort columns in search
content:
What: Map ?sort= query parameter through an enum before interpolating ORDER BY clauses.
Why: Raw column strings risked SQL errors and injection surface.
Where: crates/api/src/routes/invoices.rs.
Learned: Reject unknown sort fields with 400 Bad Request.

title: PDF invoice generation timeout on large ledgers
content:
What: Move invoice PDF rendering to background worker and paginate line items over 500 rows.
Why: Synchronous headless Chromium calls hit the 30s load balancer timeout.
Where: crates/worker/src/pdf_render.rs.
Learned: Cache rendered PDF hash in S3 and return 202 Accepted while generating.

title: Memory leak on disconnected SSE status streams
content:
What: Drop broadcast receiver and clean active connection map on axum SSE stream drop.
Why: Abrupt mobile disconnects never triggered an explicit close frame and leaked subscribers.
Where: crates/api/src/routes/events.rs.
Learned: Wrap stream state in a Drop guard to decrement gauges reliably.

title: Generic repository functions over sqlx Executor
content:
What: Write DB queries accepting impl sqlx::Executor<'_, Database = Postgres> instead of &PgPool.
Why: Lets domain services compose multiple repository calls inside one transaction.
Where: crates/core/src/repo.rs.
Learned: Avoids duplicating transactional and non-transactional method variants.

title: Typed AppError to HTTP status mapping
content:
What: Implement IntoResponse for AppError mapping Validation->400, NotFound->404, Conflict->409.
Why: Prevents internal SQL details from leaking in 500 responses.
Where: crates/api/src/error.rs.
Learned: Log internal errors with correlation_id before returning generic 500 body.

title: Exponential backoff with full jitter on retries
content:
What: Sleep random_between(0, min(cap, base * 2^attempt)) between outbound retries.
Why: Fixed exponential delays caused thundering herd retries when downstream recovered.
Where: crates/worker/src/retry.rs.
Learned: Cap retries at 8 attempts before moving jobs to dead-letter table.

title: Typed feature flag evaluation per tenant
content:
What: Evaluate feature flags through an enum with explicit default_enabled values.
Why: Stringly-typed flag checks caused silent typos in rollout conditions.
Where: crates/core/src/flags.rs.
Learned: Pass tenant plan and ID into a pure evaluation function for easy testing.

title: Propagate x-request-id across HTTP and workers
content:
What: Extract or generate x-request-id in middleware, attach to tracing span and outbox metadata.
Why: Enables tracing a failed payment from API edge through background settlement.
Where: crates/api/src/middleware/request_id.rs.
Learned: Echo x-request-id back in response headers for support debugging.

title: Circuit breaker around external tax API
content:
What: Open circuit for 30s after 5 consecutive timeouts to external VAT validation service.
Why: Hanging external HTTP calls blocked worker concurrency slots for minutes.
Where: crates/billing/src/tax_client.rs.
Learned: Fall back to cached EU VIES rates when circuit is open.

title: Redact sensitive tokens from error logs
content:
What: Strip Authorization headers and secret keys before serializing error logs.
Why: Prevented credentials from reaching centralized logging indexes.
Where: crates/core/src/telemetry.rs.
Learned: Apply redaction layer globally in tracing subscriber.

title: Nginx reverse proxy upload and buffer limits
content:
What: Set client_max_body_size 10m and proxy_read_timeout 60s in edge Nginx config.
Why: Default 1m limit rejected bulk CSV reconciliation uploads with 413.
Where: deploy/nginx/api.conf.
Learned: Keep proxy_request_buffering on for webhook endpoints so slow clients don't tie up Rust workers.

title: Docker multi-stage build with cargo-chef
content:
What: Use cargo-chef prepare/cook layers before copying crates/ source in Dockerfile.
Why: Rebuilding dependencies on every code edit took 14 minutes in CI.
Where: Dockerfile.
Learned: Copy Cargo.lock and Cargo.toml workspace manifests in the recipe stage.

title: GitHub Actions Rust cache and clippy flags
content:
What: Use Swatinem/rust-cache@v2 and run clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings.
Why: Catches pedantic regressions in tests and examples before merge.
Where: .github/workflows/ci.yml.
Learned: Separate Linux webkit system deps step with runner.os == 'Linux'.

title: Prometheus scrape and P99 latency alerts
content:
What: Scrape /metrics every 15s and alert when /v1/charges p99 exceeds 450ms for 5m.
Why: Early warning caught PgBouncer saturation before customer timeouts spiked.
Where: deploy/prometheus/alerts.yml.
Learned: Exclude healthcheck paths from HTTP latency histograms.

title: PostgreSQL autovacuum tuning on outbox_events
content:
What: Set autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor = 0.02 and cost_limit = 1000 on outbox_events.
Why: High insert/delete churn bloated outbox table and slowed worker polling scans.
Where: migrations/20260615_outbox_autovacuum.sql.
Learned: Partial index on WHERE published_at IS NULL keeps polling fast.

title: PostgreSQL migration lock_timeout safeguard
content:
What: Prefix schema ALTER TABLE migrations with SET lock_timeout = '2s'; SET statement_timeout = '10s';.
Why: An unguarded ALTER TABLE queued behind a long report and blocked all app reads.
Where: migrations/README.md.
Learned: Retry DDL in deploy hook instead of blocking live traffic.

title: Stripe test clock proration behavior on upgrades
content:
What: Stripe creates an upcoming invoice preview only after advancing the test clock past period start.
Why: Subscription upgrade tests appeared to miss proration line items.
Where: crates/billing/tests/stripe_proration.rs.
Learned: Assert invoice.lines total against integer cents after clock advance.

title: SQLx offline query cache regeneration
content:
What: Run cargo sqlx prepare --workspace after changing any query! macro or migration.
Why: Docker release builds with SQLX_OFFLINE=true fail if .sqlx/ cache is stale.
Where: .sqlx/.
Learned: Check git diff .sqlx in CI to enforce updated metadata.

title: SQLite FTS5 treats hyphens as token separators
content:
What: Unquoted hyphens in FTS5 MATCH queries act as NOT column operators unless wrapped in quotes.
Why: Searching for topic keys like auth-jwt failed with column not found errors.
Where: crates/core/src/db/search.rs.
Learned: Always double-quote search terms before passing to FTS5 MATCH.

title: Evitar deadlocks al actualizar saldos
content:
What: Ordenar los IDs de cuenta antes de tomar locks FOR UPDATE en transferencias concurrentes.
Why: Dos transferencias cruzadas en distinto orden bloqueaban mutuamente las filas.
Where: crates/billing/src/transfer.rs.
Learned: Orden canónico de bloqueos elimina interbloqueos.

title: Sprint 12: billing outbox and webhook retries
content:
What: Implemented transactional outbox table, NATS publisher worker, and dead-letter retry UI.
Why: Eliminated dropped billing notifications during pod restarts.
Where: crates/billing/src/outbox.rs, crates/worker/src/webhook_dispatcher.rs.
Learned: Next sprint focuses on RLS tenant isolation and cursor pagination.

title: Sprint 13: RLS policies and PgBouncer tuning
content:
What: Enabled PostgreSQL RLS on financial tables and switched PgBouncer to transaction pooling.
Why: Prevented cross-tenant leaks and reduced idle DB connections by 70%.
Where: deploy/pgbouncer.ini, migrations/20260502_rls_policies.sql.
Learned: Watch out for prepared statement cache incompatibility in SQLx.

title: Sprint 14: VAT timezone fix and PDF async export
content:
What: Fixed Europe/Madrid VAT report cutoff bug and moved large ledger PDF generation to worker.
Why: Resolved 1-day VAT discrepancies and eliminated 504 timeouts on enterprise accounts.
Where: crates/billing/src/vat_report.rs, crates/worker/src/pdf_render.rs.
Learned: Added Prometheus alert for charges p99 latency.

title: PostgreSQL connection pooling settings
content:
What: Configure PgBouncer transaction pool max 40 connections and 15s idle timeout.
Why: High concurrency exhausted PostgreSQL backend slots.
Where: deploy/pgbouncer.ini.
Learned: Turn off SQLx statement cache under transaction pooling.

title: Verify Stripe webhook HMAC signatures
content:
What: Check Stripe-Signature HMAC-SHA256 using raw HTTP body bytes before decoding JSON.
Why: Re-encoded JSON changes byte layout and fails HMAC verification.
Where: crates/api/src/webhooks/stripe.rs.
Learned: Enforce 5-minute timestamp tolerance window.

title: Session token Redis cache TTL policy
content:
What: Refresh Redis TTL to 1800s on active session tokens instead of plain SET.
Why: Plain SET drops expiration and keeps tokens cached indefinitely.
Where: crates/auth/src/session_store.rs.
Learned: Use SETEX or KEEPTTL on all session updates.

title: Redis token bucket rate limiter
content:
What: Use atomic Redis Lua token bucket script to rate limit tenant API requests.
Why: Prevents boundary burst spikes across minute edges.
Where: crates/api/src/middleware/ratelimit.rs.
Learned: Fail open past 25ms timeout.

title: Payment charge idempotency key handling
content:
What: Store Idempotency-Key per tenant on POST /v1/charges to avoid duplicate payments.
Why: Network retries caused double billing.
Where: crates/api/src/routes/charges.rs.
Learned: Cache charge result for 24h.

title: Configure CORS headers and allowed origins
content:
What: Permit Authorization and Idempotency-Key headers in tower-http CorsLayer.
Why: Browser preflight failed on charge requests from portal.
Where: crates/api/src/cors.rs.
Learned: Load allowed origins from CORS_ORIGINS env var.
